subject: Lapack routine dgesv: system is exactly singular:

messages.author: c8a0aee0ce32b2a8
messages.subject: Lapack routine dgesv: system is exactly singular:
parts:
Hello everyone. 

I am new to R and at the moment I am trying to work on my SEM model. 
In order to check my data for outliers, I have been trying to use mahalanobis function, but apparently I receive the error: 

Error in solve.default(cov, ...) : 
  Lapack routine dgesv: system is exactly singular: U[64,64] = 0

Could anyone provide their suggestions on how to deal with it. 
I am attaching my full code for the reference below. 
Thanks in advance. 


library(lavaan)
library(foreign)

#Import SPSS data into R, read numeric not text values
Analysis<-read.spss("168_case_dataset.sav",to.data.frame=TRUE, use.value.labels = FALSE)

#To see the summary of variables
summary(Analysis)
  
#missing values - to show what data is missing 
percentmissing = function (Analysis){sum(is.na(Analysis))/length(Analysis) * 100}
missing =apply(Analysis, 1, percentmissing)
table(missing)

#to check whether columns aren't missing too much data
apply(Analysis, 2, percentmissing)

install.packages("mice")

#replace away 
library(mice)
tempnomiss = mice(Analysis)
nomiss = complete(tempnomiss, 1)
summary(nomiss)

#exclude some columns
Dataset_var_IDLE_SNFE = subset(nomiss, select = -c(EAct, Livingabroad, Studyingabroad, PVLTMax, 
                                                   PVLTOverallPercentag::SDMINTRO28)) 

#outliers 
cutoff = qchisq(1-.001, ncol(Dataset_var_IDLE_SNFE))
mahal = mahalanobis(Dataset_var_IDLE_SNFE,
                    colMeans(Dataset_var_IDLE_SNFE),
                    cov(Dataset_var_IDLE_SNFE))

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Lapack routine dgesv: system is exactly singular:
parts:
The error is produced by the mahalanobis() distance. Not lavaan. It
would seem that 'cov' matrix is singular...

Yves.
